focus: The prepare/consume CLI and the skilled-loop wrapper: duplicated decisions and unverified assumptions
noveltyJustification: All four findings are new to this run; the reachability result for the wrapper's fallback branch is established from control flow rather than from a prior record.
answeredQuestions: Which latent bugs or edge cases does `bin/session-relaunch.cjs` and the `.skilled/bin/skilled-loop` wrapper still carry after the phase 009 fixes?

Reporting the note's unused cwd and loop_id frontmatter as a defect: they are documented provenance

label: The handoffs directory layout is declared twice: nudge.cjs:243 builds it for every planned note while bin/session-relaunch.cjs:128 declares HANDOFF_SEGMENTS and rejects anything outside it at :141, and nudge.handoffDir is not exported (:488), so the CLI cannot share it; a layout change silently fails as 'handoff path must be inside the session-relaunch handoffs directory'. Fix: export handoffDir from nudge and derive the CLI's segments from path.relative(repoRoot, handoffDir(root)), deleting HANDOFF_SEGMENTS.

print_manual_command's fallback half can never run: build_manual_command_template always embeds @@HANDOFF@@ (skilled-loop:239) because every runtime branch of build_relaunch_arguments sets relaunch_seed_index (:169,:175), and the template is exported before the loop (:393), so the case at :49 always takes the single-token branch. The unreachable block still duplicates core.manualClaimCommand's escape set (relaunch-core.cjs:584) and RUNTIME_SEED_OPTIONS (relaunch-core.cjs:26). Fix: delete the fallback and raise a visible error when the template is unusable; also reconcile the stream split (wrapper stderr at skilled-loop:65, CLI stdout at session-relaunch.cjs:292).

refuseForShellChild trusts CLAUDE_PID without the descent check that resolveKillerTarget applies to the same variable: bin/session-relaunch.cjs:265 converts it straight to a pid and inspects that subtree, while relaunch-core.cjs:844 accepts it only when findLoopChildPid confirms it descends from the loop. A stale CLAUDE_PID inherited from an outer shell makes prepare read an unrelated process's children and refuse a valid prepare with 'still has a live shell child'. Fix: verify with core.findLoopChildPid and fall back to runtimePidFromLoop when the check fails.

main()'s unknown-command message hardcodes the subcommand list at bin/session-relaunch.cjs:605 even though SUBCOMMANDS is declared the only place the syntax is written (:24); a sixth subcommand would appear in usageText() and usageHint() and be missing from the message a caller sees after typing a wrong command. Fix: Object.keys(SUBCOMMANDS).join(', ').

reason: Phase 009's L1 fix holds: the real handoffs directory is compared against the real repository root (:157) and then the real parent of the candidate (:172)
